answer_1.quote: We propose a new benchmark, OpenCQA, for answering open-ended questions about charts using descriptive texts.
answer_1.outputs: descriptive answers to open-ended questions about charts

answer_2.quote: We utilized six measures for automatic evaluation. BLEU  measures n-gram overlaps between the model generated text and the reference.

answer_4.quote: To further assess the quality of the answers generated by the models, we performed a human study on 150 randomly sampled charts from our OpenCQA dataset with three internal annotators who are native speakers of English.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators assess each answer based on three criteria adapted from : (i) Factual correctness, (ii) Relevance, (iii) Fluency, and a new recall-oriented criteria called Content Coverage.
